blocks.text: Re: Appeal of adverse benefit determination, reference B-3117. Home health skilled nursing and physical therapy.

We request reconsideration of the denial dated October 5, 2026. The denial cites Medical Policy MP-HH-007, Section 3.1(c). We ask that the request be reviewed under Section 3.3 of the same policy, which covers home health services ordered in place of a facility admission without certification of homebound status.
The member meets Plan criteria for skilled nursing facility admission after right hip hemiarthroplasty, as documented by her case manager.

Her home was evaluated by an occupational therapist and found clinically appropriate and safe, and her daughter lives with her, is available 24 hours a day and has completed transfer and injection training.
The expected cost of the ordered home health services is $4,350, compared with $10,400 for a 20-day skilled nursing facility stay.
The services were ordered by her surgeon under a written plan of care after a face-to-face encounter on 10/01/2026, and she needs skilled nursing and skilled physical therapy.
The enclosed records satisfy Section 3.3(a) through 3.3(c). We ask that the denial be overturned.
